claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The project is a research and hands-on demo exploring Palantir-style operational knowledge graphs for factory and manufacturing intelligence, covering ontology design, live data ingestion, decision logic, and governed actions using open datasets.
claims.quote: Research and hands-on demo project exploring Palantir-style operational knowledge graphs for factory/manufacturing intelligence — covering ontology design, live data ingestion, decision logic, and governed actions using open datasets.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The implementation uses two parallel demos, each with a passive knowledge graph track and an operational context graph track with governed actions.
claims.quote: Implements two parallel demos — AI4I predictive maintenance and SECOM semiconductor yield — each with Track A (passive knowledge graph) and Track B (operational context graph with governed actions).

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The core framework includes ontology components, governance, actions, and rule-based functions: object types, link types, graph sessions with Pydantic validation, RBAC permission checks, a Postgres audit log, an action base class with preconditions/execute/audit/rollback, and RuleBasedFunction with optional Neo4j store-back.
claims.quote: Core framework (Phases 0–1): - core/ontology: ObjectType, LinkType, GraphSession with Pydantic validation - core/governance: RBAC permission checks + Postgres audit log - core/actions: Action base class (preconditions → execute → audit → rollback) - core/functions: RuleBasedFunction base class with optional Neo4j store-back

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: AI4I Track B predicts failure risk using four rule signals (TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF) and provides a TriggerMaintenance action, exposed via FastAPI on port 8000 and a Streamlit dashboard on port 8502.
claims.quote: AI4I demo (Phase 2): - Pipeline: 10K UCI sensor records → 4 refined CSVs (machines/tool_runs/failure_modes/links) - Track A: Neo4j loader + 5-page Streamlit explorer (Overview/Machines/Runs/Failures/Cypher) - Track B: PredictFailureRisk (4 rule signals: TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF), TriggerMaintenance action, FastAPI on :8000, Streamlit dashboard on :8502

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: SECOM Track B predicts yield risk using three risk signals (alarm count/max sigma/NA rate) and provides a HoldLot action, exposed via FastAPI on port 8001 and a Streamlit dashboard on port 8504.
claims.quote: SECOM demo (Phase 3): - Pipeline: 1,567 lots × 590 sensors → SPC 3σ alarms → 440 alarm nodes, 6,115 links - Track A: Neo4j loader + 5-page Streamlit explorer with SPC alarm co-occurrence analysis - Track B: PredictYieldRisk (3 risk signals: alarm count/max sigma/NA rate), HoldLot action, FastAPI on :8001, Streamlit dashboard on :8504

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The report includes side-by-side latency, risk distribution, and test coverage; 149 tests pass and both loaders are idempotent using MERGE semantics.
claims.quote: Report (Phase 4): - notebooks/comparison.ipynb: side-by-side latency, risk distribution, test coverage - docs/learnings.md: 4-layer test, GPS analogy, dataset mapping guide, design decisions 149 tests passing. Both loaders idempotent (MERGE semantics).
